text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- King Juan Carlos of Spain at the end of his visit to Egypt says he encourages increased tourism investment in Egypt, and he expects a rise in the number of Spanish tourists to Egypt in the coming season.
- Egypt and Tunisia hold talks on how to increase trade.

- U.S. Ambassador to Egypt Edward Walker says that Mubarak's visit to the United States on March 10 comes at a very important time, as President Bill Clinton starts his second term and there is a new secretary of state.
- Interior Minister Hassan al-Alfi to open a three-day conference on terrorism.
- Egypt is coordinating with Syria and Saudi Arabia on ways to implement the peace process.
- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri to sign an agreement setting up a free trade zone between Tunisia and Egypt next week.
- Ministry of transport is preparing a legal regime which aims to allow a private sector airline to be established.
- Moussa says that there are intensive Arab efforts to maintain the Middle East peace process.
